newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ECNZ to begin sale of Mangahao power station.
newsitem.headline: ECNZ to begin sale of Mangahao power station.

text.p: State-owned power generator Electricity Corp of New Zealand said on Friday it was proceeding with the process of selling its 130 GWh Mangahao hydro-electric power station near Shannon in the lower North Island.
ECNZ General Manager Business Development Trevor Taylor said the sale would help other players enter the New Zealand electricity industry.
ECNZ said it wanted to complete the sale within 18 months.
A memorandum of understanding with the government signed in June 1995 said the station should be available for sale on a commercial basis to energy companies and/or Maori interests within the region.
"We will call for formal expressions of interest in Mangahao from eligible parties shortly," Taylor said.
The station can supply five percent of the electricity needs of Wellington, Porirua and the Hutt Valley.
